name: Check Destiny after timeout
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; timeout 45 sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca 'podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}"; code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:12347/api/health || true); echo health=$code'
description: Check Destiny’s container and new WebUI port after the recreate command timed out.
